name: is_player_controllable

stack.evidence: func_001D2580 replaces the top restriction mask with the boolean result of func_00125BB8

notes: func_00125BB8 returns false when controller mode D_002DF6C0 is 3, global flags 0x12000 are set, or the player-control-disable bit 0x2 in D_002DF6B0 is set. Mask bit 0 adds player-validity and contact-orientation checks, bit 1 rejects player states 3, 7, and 8, and bit 2 requires player field 0x70 to be zero. All 27 JP calls pass mask 0, immediately store the result, and consume it as a boolean gate.
